parameters.name: interlayer_thickness
parameters.justification: Thin weak interlayer between lamellae; sets interlayer shear stiffness k = G_i/h_i.

parameters.name: fouled_patch_length
parameters.justification: Streamwise length of a fouled patch whose accumulated drag loads the lamella edge (film force per width N0 = tau_f * L_patch).

parameters.name: shear_lag_domain_length
parameters.justification: Length over which the lamella transfers its edge force into the interlayer; ~10 shear-lag decay lengths sqrt(E t h_i / G_i) = 32 um, so u(1)=0 is a far-field condition. x is normalised by this length.
